title: 4.17 La visita de la familia
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Help Ana with her family's visit: find the things in her living room, where each family member stands, who hides where in a game of hide-and-seek and which lamp is on or off, and answer Ana's friends aloud about the kitchen, her grandmother's birthday, how often the boy plays football, a painting and the apples.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.17 Un día en casa: A1 closes Unit 4 helping a family get its home ready for a visit; A1+ 4.17 closes A1+ Unit 4 with the visit of Ana's family to her apartment, with no new language. The learner finds things with There are some … (4.15), Ana's grandparents and parents with behind and in front of (4.3), the hiders in a game of hide-and-seek (4.3) and the lamp that is off from an isn't clue (4.2), and answers Ana's friends aloud: Did you clean the kitchen? (4.7-4.8, 4.11), When is your grandmother's birthday? (4.13), How often does he play football? (4.12), Did you paint this last year? (4.9, 4.14) and Are there any apples? (4.15). 4.10's clock times stay in 4.10.
speaking_outcome: Answer four friends aloud for Ana: that she cleaned the kitchen yesterday, the date of her grandmother's birthday, how often the boy plays football, who painted the painting and where the apples are.
